verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is Kimi's core interaction model. The docs describe conversational control in Kimi Code Desktop and the terminal CLI, where the agent reads code, edits files, runs commands and verifies results "through conversation" (kimi-docs-1, kimi-docs-2). The kimi.com entry point invites users to ask anything or start an Agent task (kimi-docs-21), with agent mode and multi-turn web-building also documented (kimi-docs-15, kimi-docs-17); community users report hands-on prompt-driven use (kimi-comm-12, kimi-comm-15). missing for 10: depth of first-party documentation on the natural-language command set itself, and hands-on reports of reliable execution — some users describe overthinking or broken code on agentic tasks (kimi-comm-13, kimi-comm-18).
